reason: The README describes a verification skill that checks claims in design documents and refactoring plans against code and performs structural and adversarial logic validation, making testing and debugging its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 用于核验设计文档与重构计划中的可验证声明，并对状态机模型执行结构化和对抗性逻辑检查。
summaries.en: Verifies testable claims in design documents and refactoring plans against the codebase and applies structural and adversarial logic checks to state-machine models.

capabilities: Reads project files when invoked for claim verification
Analyzes design documents, architecture specifications, and refactoring plans
Performs structural and adversarial logic checks on extracted state-machine models
May run an optional bundled Python verification harness
Injects configured verification guidance into an agent session context
